problems: Seam: naqada-culture (another group) ends -3000 but early-dynastic-period-of-egypt starts -3150 (page: c. 3150 BC); 150 years overlap to reconcile.

Hyksos and Cliopatria's Fifteenth Dynasty of Egypt (slug fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt, another batch) are one dynasty (Avaris, 1650-c. 1550); one dossier should be merged or demoted. Cliopatria's Sixteenth Dynasty shape lies in the Delta while the pages put the dynasty at Thebes.

upper-egypt and middle-kingdom-of-egypt are one continuous state (Thebes under Mentuhotep II, 2055); early-dynastic, old-kingdom and middle-kingdom are periods of one Egyptian state (family egypt): colour merge candidates.
lower-egypt IS the Herakleopolitan kingdom and upper-egypt IS the Theban kingdom of the First Intermediate Period, so me-03-x need not write them.

Dates follow the Wikipedia infobox c. values, not Cliopatria's 100-year block edges; every dossier's start/end differs from Cliopatria's row and the adjacent dossiers hand over in the same year (-2686, -2181, -2055, -1650).

The pages disagree on several dates (First Intermediate Period end c. 2055 vs defeat of Heracleopolis around 2033; Hyksos end c. 1550 vs c. 1532; Kamose's campaign c. 1553, c. 1542 or c. 1545-1540); each conflict is in the dossier's notes.
WebFetch returns a model's extract of the page, not raw text: quoted phrases are the extract's quotations of the page; paraphrases are not in quotation marks. Ten distinct pages in twelve fetches.
